definitions.gloss: communication charges; data charges; telecom fees
definitions.explanation: Fees charged for telecommunications services such as phone calls, text messages, and mobile data usage.

examples.japanese: {通信料|つうしんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通信料|つうしんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the monthly communication charges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通信料|つうしんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高額|こうがく}→高額：14704_kougaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need to be careful because communication charges can become very expensive overseas.

notes:
Refers to charges for phone, data, and other telecommunications services. In everyday use, often refers specifically to mobile phone data charges.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信料|つうしんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{掛|か}かる — communication charges are incurred
- {通信料|つうしんりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧ — free of data charges
- ⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧{通信料|つうしんりょう} — monthly communication fee
- {通信料|つうしんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧ — to save on data charges

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通話料|つうわりょう}→通話料：16275_tsuuwaryou⟧ — call charges (voice calls specifically)
- {通信費|つうしんひ} — communication expenses (broader, used in accounting)
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧{使用量|しようりょう} — data usage amount
